scenes.title: At the Iron Gate
scenes.summary: Nour brings tea to the courtyard table as Rami uses her three simple sentences to break the ice with Ziad.

scenes.title: The Wooden Train
scenes.summary: Rami hands Ziad their grandfather's carved wooden train just as childhood piano teacher Suad steps over to greet them.

scenes.title: Thirty Days on Paper
scenes.summary: Behind the front desk Mazen laments the sale notice while Tariq and Nour urge him not to give up without reading the fine print.

scenes.title: Lemon Cake and Sharp Eyes
scenes.summary: Enjoying Salma's warm lemon cake, Ziad notices the worried faces inside the lobby window and offers help.

scenes.title: Page Two, Clause Fourteen
scenes.summary: Examining page two of the letter, Rami points out Heritage Clause 14 protecting historic buildings with public ground-floor cafés.

scenes.title: Permanent Keys
scenes.summary: Beaming with relief, Mazen greenlights Salma's morning courtyard café and offers Nour the permanent front-desk job.

scenes.title: Under the Golden Lanterns
scenes.summary: As evening lanterns glow across the courtyard, Nour, Suad, and Ziad toast the week's unexpected friendships.

scenes.title: Room Nine
scenes.summary: Fetching spare café chairs from the cellar, Tariq uncovers a locked wooden crate stamped 'Room 9' and a ninth brass key.
